scope: Official public research institution and university THz spectral repositories; prioritize THz-TDS raw waveforms or numerical refractive-index/absorption spectra. No NIR/VIS leaf reflectance dataset is a main candidate here.

status_definitions.verified_metadata_not_downloaded: Institutional metadata explicitly describes numerical files and a download route; files were not downloaded or executed in this search.
status_definitions.database_terms_only: Official identity and permission to download text data verified, but individual spectral records, their measurement method and their files were not inspected.
status_definitions.historical_reference: Official historical evidence exists, but current downloadable numerical files were not verified.

overall_findings: This institutional search has not verified a public multi-region Suanzaoren/Ziziphus spinosa seed THz-TDS dataset with true growing-origin and independent batch labels.
Cambridge is the clearest small open raw-waveform example, including baseline, reference and sample; the French GT-CNRS dataset is the closest verified numerical n/alpha matrix example.
The Strathclyde datasets explicitly include sample thickness, but .tprj files require a compatible reader/exporter before a Python numerical pipeline can consume them.

The confirmed materials differ from herbal powders. They can validate signal processing and classification procedures, but cannot establish Suanzaoren origin accuracy or be pooled as equivalent origin-labelled samples.
No datasets were downloaded, no models were fitted and no accuracy results were produced by this source search.

main_candidates.title: Data to accompany 'Tutorial: accurate determination of refractive index and absorption coefficient in terahertz time-domain spectroscopy'
main_candidates.institution: University of Cambridge, Apollo repository, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology
main_candidates.official_identity_evidence: Cambridge university institutional repository; item identified as Dataset.
main_candidates.measurement_type: THz time-domain spectroscopy, raw transmitted electric-field waveforms
materials: lactose alpha-monohydrate mixed with polyethylene sample pellet
main_candidates.numerical_data: Raw numerical waveforms in HDF5, not just figures; supplied Python script reproduces publication figures and the optical-constant analysis.
main_candidates.thickness: Related tutorial uses pellet thickness and software can identify thickness metadata, but numerical thickness values and their placement in this particular HDF5 file were not inspected.
main_candidates.plant_or_herb_labels: No plant species/origin task; this is a lactose model powder example.
main_candidates.growing_origin_labels: not provided as a plant-origin classification task
main_candidates.independent_batch_labels: not verified; tutorial example should not be treated as a large independent-sample benchmark
main_candidates.license: CC BY 4.0, except where otherwise noted on the item
main_candidates.access_conditions: Public institutional download route. The current v2 is important: the erroneous original LMPE_publ.thz was removed and replaced on 2025-08-07. Direct web-page fetch timed out in this search; indexed official metadata was inspected.
main_candidates.best_use: Validate time-domain to frequency-domain to n/alpha extraction on a small powder/PE example before applying it to the user's THz Excel files.
main_candidates.not_suitable_for: Estimating Suanzaoren origin accuracy or few-shot origin generalization without the user's independent herbal batches.

main_candidates.title: Replication Data for: Terahertz time-domain spectroscopy supports classification of human kidney stone sections
main_candidates.institution: Georgia Tech-CNRS IRL2958; Georgia Tech-Europe; CNRS/Universite de Lorraine partners, distributed by Recherche Data Gouv
main_candidates.official_identity_evidence: French national research-data repository names CNRS, Georgia Tech-Europe, Georgia Institute of Technology, CRAN and CHRU among producers.
main_candidates.measurement_type: Transmission THz-TDS using TeraView TPS Spectra 3000; deposited data are extracted optical constants
materials: human kidney stone sections: calcium oxalate monohydrate, uric acid, struvite, cystine

files.name: Codes.zip
files.contents: Python loading, processing and classification scripts

main_candidates.numerical_data: CSV under stone and patch directories, explicitly named refractive_index_and_absorption_coefficient_spectra_by_pixel.csv. Variables include frequency, n(nu), alpha(nu), stone ID and subtype. Full public ZIP is approximately 16.2 MB.
main_candidates.frequency_range: Deposited extracted spectra: 0.2-2.2 THz; instrument nominal range in metadata: 60 GHz-3 THz.
main_candidates.sample_hierarchy: Stone -> patch -> pixel. Four stones per subtype; pixels and patches are repeated measurements nested within a stone.
main_candidates.baseline_waveform: not confirmed among the deposited file descriptions
main_candidates.reference_waveform: not confirmed among the deposited file descriptions
main_candidates.sample_waveform: acquired experimentally, but deposit described as extracted n/alpha rather than raw temporal traces
main_candidates.thickness: not verified in public file descriptions
main_candidates.independent_batch_labels: Stone ID is available; clinical/sample acquisition batch labels were not verified.
main_candidates.access_conditions: Public file access, v1 published 2026-08-08. Direct page fetch timed out; indexed official metadata, file names and dataset structure were inspectable.
main_candidates.best_use: A same-measurement-domain numerical n/alpha classification benchmark for checking the existing pipeline and grouped small-sample evaluation.
critical_validation_notes: Split by Stone ID, not by random pixels or patches, to avoid leakage.
Metadata identifies two XRD-based outliers (3a_10431 and 5a_18398), included in the deposit but excluded from the publication's training; follow the documented sample policy.
Verify actual CSV alpha units before importing: repository metadata allows cm^-1 or m^-1.
main_candidates.not_suitable_for: Plant or herbal geographic-origin inference; this dataset's labels are mineralogical subtypes.

main_candidates.title: Data for: Polymer Pellet Fabrication for Accurate THz-TDS Measurements
main_candidates.institution: University of Strathclyde, Institute of Pharmacy and Biomedical Sciences
main_candidates.official_identity_evidence: University's Pure institutional research-data record explicitly identifies University of Strathclyde as publisher.
main_candidates.numerical_data: Raw THz-TDS in .tprj; YAML thickness metadata; Axial_Relaxation.xlsx for each material. This is a numerical instrument-project container rather than ready-to-import CSV.
main_candidates.sample_waveform: raw TDS data explicitly deposited; individual channel contents not inspected
main_candidates.thickness: explicitly supplied: accompanying YAML records pre-analysis sample thickness measurements
main_candidates.access_conditions: Public download link; embargo ended 2022-04-10. Automated direct-file fetch returned HTTP403 in this web search; that is an access limitation of the current probe, not evidence that the public record or file is absent.
main_candidates.best_use: Investigate pellet fabrication, thickness and mechanical relaxation as confounders in powder TDS processing.
main_candidates.not_suitable_for: Herbal geographic-origin training; .tprj import/export compatibility must first be checked.

main_candidates.title: Data for: The Effect of Particle Size and Concentration on Low-Frequency Terahertz Scattering in Granular Compacts
main_candidates.institution: University of Strathclyde, Institute of Pharmacy and Biomedical Sciences / Pure and Applied Chemistry
main_candidates.official_identity_evidence: University's institutional dataset record, publisher University of Strathclyde, made available 2024-06-07.
main_candidates.measurement_type: Raw THz time-domain spectroscopy of granular compacts
main_candidates.numerical_data: Raw .tprj files and accompanying YAML thickness records; an additional .mat file is listed. Numerical instrument containers, not merely plots; contents were not parsed.
main_candidates.sample_waveform: raw TDS data explicitly deposited; individual channel contents not inspected
main_candidates.thickness: explicitly supplied per TDS file in accompanying YAML
main_candidates.independent_batch_labels: particle size/concentration conditions are the scientific design; exact sample/batch identifier fields not inspected
main_candidates.license: CC BY 4.0 for the listed files
main_candidates.access_conditions: Public institutional download links. Automated fetch of one ZIP returned HTTP403 in this web search. Same repository/institution as the polymer pellet dataset, so these are two datasets, not two independent platforms.
main_candidates.best_use: Study particle-size and concentration scattering effects that may otherwise be mistaken for herbal chemical/origin differences.
main_candidates.not_suitable_for: Herbal geographic-origin classification; a .tprj reader/exporter is required.

main_candidates.title: Terahertz Database (THzDB)
main_candidates.institution: RIKEN and National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT), Japan
main_candidates.official_identity_evidence: RIKEN's official research-team page states it developed the online database in cooperation with NICT, opened in 2009.
main_candidates.measurement_type: THz-region spectroscopic database; per-record TDS versus other measurement techniques must be checked
main_candidates.tds_confirmed: not verified for individual records; do not label the entire database THz-TDS
main_candidates.numerical_data: Current terms explicitly permit viewing/downloading text data and images for noncommercial use; an individual numerical file was not reached through the acceptance page.
main_candidates.plant_or_herb_labels: Specific herb/seed species coverage, including Suanzaoren, not verified.
main_candidates.license: Copyrighted; free noncommercial viewing/download, with written permission required for reproduction/distribution of extracts or entire materials.
main_candidates.access_conditions: Accept website terms; personal details described as optional. Do not mirror files to GitHub without the committee's written permission. RIKEN's historical count above 1200 is not independently verified as the present number.
main_candidates.best_use: Official reference-spectrum search for candidate constituents, sugars, polymers and related materials, conditional on per-record modality and metadata checks.
main_candidates.not_suitable_for: Assuming a ready-made multi-origin herbal TDS training set or unrestricted redistribution.

reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.title: THz-BRIDGE spectral database of selected biological systems
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.institution: European Commission FP5 project QLK4-CT-2000-00129; coordinated by ENEA, Italy
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.materials: Historical official report lists approximately 50 spectra of amino acids, proteins, blood constituents and skin.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.measurement_type: Not a confirmed pure-TDS dataset. Official project report also describes FTIR and monochromatic BWO/Mach-Zehnder measurements for materials/plasticware.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.numerical_download: Current operational raw-numerical download route not verified; historical URL is not a verified live download.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.license: CORDIS describes historical biological database as public domain under the project contract; this alone does not verify availability or current file terms.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.access_conditions: Project ended 2004, results last updated 2005, official CORDIS page archived 2024. Reference/history tier only.

reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD69 THz Spectral Database
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.institution: U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.materials: Powder reference materials including cellulose, starch, sugars, flour, ground coffee and caffeine; not geographically labelled herbal specimens.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.measurement_type: FTIR far-infrared/THz transmission, modified Nicolet Magna550, incoherent filament source and DTGS detector; not THz-TDS electric-field traces.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.numerical_download: Per-record downloadable JCAMP-DX spectrum; cellulose direct link confirmed. Web reader reports unsupported chemical/x-jcamp-dx content type, so contents were not parsed.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.reference_waveform: No time-domain electric field. Method ratios sample-pellet spectrum to PE blank spectrum.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.sample_waveform: No time-domain electric field; final transmission spectrum.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.thickness: General method gives approximately 2 mm pellet thickness; per-sample measured thickness not verified.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.plant_or_herb_labels: Substance/material labels; no verified Suanzaoren coverage.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.license: NIST SRD copyright terms apply; record explicitly states compilation/collection copyright, so do not assume all WebBook data are unrestricted public domain.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.best_use: Component fingerprint/reference comparison only, after units and measurement-method differences are handled.
reference_only_or_not_same_measurement.not_suitable_for: Directly pooling with THz-TDS n/alpha origin-classification rows or reconstructing TDS phase from transmission alone.
